projects.permission.title: AYAR needs permission to read this folder
projects.permission.explain: macOS refused to read the folder in “{location}”. AYAR only reads files and never writes into your project.
projects.permission.steps: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders, allow AYAR for “{location}”, then press “Try again”.
projects.preExplain: macOS will ask, once, to let AYAR access “{location}”, because the folder did not come through the open panel. AYAR reads the project’s files to discover its checks, and writes nothing into it.
projects.confirm.home_folder: You selected your whole home folder. AYAR will read everything in it within the discovery limits, which may take a while. Continue?
projects.confirm.disk_root: You selected the root of the disk. That is a very wide scope for one project. Continue?
projects.confirm.identity_mismatch: The new folder does not look like the same project: it was “{expected}”, and this one is “{found}”. Link it anyway?
projects.pathStatus.permission_denied: No permission to read the path
projects.removed: AYAR’s data about the project was deleted; the repository was not touched.
projects.untrusted.label: Untrusted project
projects.untrusted.explain: In this mode the project’s commands do not run; only reading and read-only tools work. AYAR is not a sandbox.
